items.text: Puka Nacua listed QUESTIONABLE (calf) for Sunday; McVay says minor, will test pregame after limited/DNP practices. Status crucial.
items.why: Calf felt lack of power/explosion; left practice Thu, DNP Fri.
items.implication: Game-time; if OUT opens targets for TE/WR hierarchy.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Higbee primary target sink.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed QUESTIONABLE (ankle) for Sunday vs CIN. Status very crucial to slate.
items.why: Returned but walking with limp earlier; official Q.
items.implication: Monitor early news; backup implications if OUT.

items.text: Breece Hall listed QUESTIONABLE (quad) for Sunday. Crucial DFS status.
items.why: Sat Wed, limited later; not ruled out.
items.implication: If active vs MIA, full starter.

items.text: Official OUTs include Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel, Brian Robinson, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, David Montgomery, Jeremiyah Love, Rashee Rice, Zach Charbonnet, Davante Adams.
If Puka Nacua (calf) can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell 5. Jordan Whittington 6. Davis Allen.
items.why: Adams already OUT; entire WR corps thin.
items.implication: Higbee becomes high-upside TE1/WR flex if Puka inactive.

items.text: Saquon Barkley will return Week 7; if out there vs Cowboys, going right back into fantasy lineups (agrees with Stephania Bell).
items.why: Efficient in prior full games; matchup vs DAL.

items.text: If Breece Hall plays vs Miami Dolphins, going right back into starting lineup (despite Stephania concern).
items.why: Lead role if cleared; favorable matchup.

items.text: Colston Loveland is BACK (thank Caleb). Since Williams return: 30% target share, 19.2 PPR/game, 6+ rec and 60+ yards both games.
items.why: Elevated with Caleb; Kmet now IR season-ending adds more.

items.text: Really sweet setup for Bijan Robinson Sunday with Brian Robinson OUT. 49ers DvP inflates opposing RB by 4.4% (7th-most); recent RB catches: White 4-30-1, Holani 4-24, Harvey 10-68, Love 5-19-1.
items.why: BRob OUT + SF soft vs RB receiving.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts Sunday because scheme awesome and 49ers entire WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT). Not because National TE Day.
items.why: WR injuries funnel targets to Kittle.

items.text: Rarely buy RB-as-WR statements, but given 49ers dire WR situation and Kaelon Black, tempted to buy CMC lining up more in slot. CMC smiled at question.
The more I watch Jaylen Warren, the more I love his game. Steelers have something special.
Luther Burden only 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR. Kmet IR season-ending may reduce 2/3-TE sets, giving Burden more juice.
items.why: Kmet to IR (Rapoport/Schefter confirm season-ending knee).
